row.evidence: Delinea publishes no prices (its Buy/Try page offers only free trials and sales contact), while its docs say the Delinea SCIM Cloud "enables IAM/IGA providers to securely integrate with the Delinea Platform using the SCIM 2.0 protocol".
row.notes: Quote-only: Delinea lists no plans or prices; delinea.com/pricing is 404 and the Buy/Try page only offers 30-day trials, demos and sales contact, so SCIM can only be bought through sales. Scored on the Delinea Platform (the cloud admin product that hosts Secret Server on the Platform, Privilege Manager and the rest). The Platform's SCIM Cloud connector (https://<tenant>.delinea.app/scim/v2, OAuth2 client-credentials token from a service user) documents create, read, PUT/PATCH update, deactivate (active=false) and DELETE for Users plus full Groups CRUD and membership, with Entra ID and Okta guides (both custom/non-gallery or generic SCIM template apps, so idp is via_generic) and SailPoint-style IGA use; it also exposes PAM-extension Containers/PrivilegedData/ContainerPermissions resources. SCIM role support is not implemented yet. Delinea also has an older self-installed 'On-Prem SCIM' for Secret Server. SAML/OIDC federation is documented for Okta, OneLogin, Google and others. Okta's OIN 'Delinea Secret Server' app is SAML only; Microsoft's gallery has a Secret Server (on-premises) SSO tutorial. A non-SCIM Identity REST API (OAuth2 bearer) covers user create/update/state/remove and local groups.

plans.name: Delinea Platform (quote-only)
plans.price_text: Contact sales (no public pricing; 30-day free trials)
plans.notes: No public tier table. SSO, SCIM and APIs are documented for the Delinea Platform without any plan gate being stated.

auth.token_source: Access > Users > More > Add Service User (OAuth2 client credentials; token from https://<your-hostname>.delinea.app/identity/api/oauth2/token/xpmplatform with scope xpmheadless)
auth.token_expiry: Access token expires_in 3609 seconds in the documented example; refresh token typically 12 hours

deprovision.data_retained: Entra and Okta send PATCH active=false to disable the user; Entra later sends DELETE (hard delete) 30 days after a soft delete.

filtering.notes: Only eq and co operators; Entra docs also show externalId eq queries.

attributes.notes: Docs say the standard User and EnterpriseUser schemas are supported but list no enterprise-extension attributes. The Platform keeps no separate first/last name, so Okta must map them. userName comes from the Entra and Okta endpoint pages.

roles.how: Role support (Get Roles / Get Role by ID) is planned but not implemented; groups sync as Platform groups.

rate_limits.text: No server rate limit documented; Okta enforces a 60-second timeout per SCIM request, so batches of 50-100 users are recommended.

limitations.text: Changing userName in Okta suspends the existing Platform user and creates a new one.
Okta setup needs an Okta SAML app as the container for SCIM (AIW method uses PUT only; OIN SCIM 2.0 template uses PATCH).
Only the first email and first phone number in the arrays are processed.
SCIM role endpoints are not yet implemented ("once SCIM Cloud enters public preview").
Changes made directly in the Platform can be overwritten by the next IdP sync.

scim.notes: Base URL as documented in the Entra and Okta configuration pages.

auth.notes: Bearer JWT from the OAuth2 client-credentials grant of a Platform service user.

endpoints.purpose: Create a new user in the Cloud Directory Service
Fetch a user by id or name
Invite one or more users to the cloud portal
Remove a user from the cloud
Add principals to a local group

user_api.notes: Endpoints from the Identity OpenAPI file linked from the Platform API reference (docs.delinea.com/online-help/platform-api/identity.htm). Secret Server also has its own REST API, not recorded here.

okta.notes: OIN lists Delinea Secret Server with SAML only (last updated Jul 28 2023). Delinea Platform SCIM with Okta uses an AIW SAML app or the generic SCIM 2.0 template app, not a Delinea catalogue app.

entra.notes: Microsoft gallery tutorial covers Secret Server (on-premises) SSO only. Delinea Platform SCIM with Entra uses a non-gallery app.

onelogin.notes: From Delinea's own guide: SAML/OIDC federation with OneLogin; no OneLogin SCIM setup documented.

fallbacks.other_sync: Active Directory connector and Microsoft Entra ID direct API integration as identity sources; older self-installed On-Prem SCIM for Secret Server

open_questions: No public pricing: which Delinea Platform packages include SCIM, SSO and API access is not stated.
Whether SCIM deactivation frees a licence or ends active sessions is not documented.
Whether ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas and ResourceTypes discovery endpoints exist is not documented.
SCIM Cloud FAQ says role support comes "once SCIM Cloud enters public preview", suggesting the connector may still be pre-GA.
